objective: Deliver the W1 hardware-independent environment foundation.

claims.statement: Persisted place data contains keyed AP tokens, never raw network identifiers.
checks: SipHash reference-vector and key-isolation tests pass.
Persistence headers and codec contain no SSID or BSSID fields.

claims.statement: Location decisions implement the documented thresholds, confirmation delay, scan semantics, and lock.
checks: Location and fingerprint Host tests pass.
A new place cannot be committed before a consistent scan after 20 seconds.

claims.statement: Wild rewards cannot settle more than once per 30-minute cooldown, including conservative restart handling.
Place catalog encoding is versioned, checksummed, bounded, and rejects ambiguous records.
checks: Codec round-trip, corruption, duplicate ID, and duplicate token tests pass.

claims.statement: All W1 Host targets compile cleanly and pass sanitizer-backed tests.
checks: A clean tools/test-host.sh run exits successfully.

non_goals: Game UI, spawning, capture, and bestiary
